# Radiation Shielding Products for Nuclear Energy, Nuclear Medicine and NDT

Since 1979, MarShield has been a North American leader in radiation shielding and lead shielding
manufacturing. As a trusted global supplier, we support industries where safety, compliance, and
performance are mandatory.

We work across [nuclear energy][92], [nuclear medicine][93], [diagnostic imaging][94],
[non-destructive testing][95], and design-build environments. Our team provides design guidance and
technical consultation to deliver **radiation shielding products** built to your exact
specifications.

### Our Shielding Materials:
* [Lead][96]
* [Lead Glass][97]
* [Lead Acrylic][98]
* [Non-lead Alternatives][99]
* [Tungsten][100]
* [Borated Polyethylene][101]
* [High Density Concrete][102]

[[We Design, Manufacture & Deliver]][103]

### MarShield holds CWB accreditation

MarShield Radiation Shielding holds CWB accreditation to [**CSA N299.3-16**][104] for the supply of
shielding solutions to nuclear energy facilities and regulated industries across Canada and the
United States.
* ## **Let’s Start With A Quote**
  
  MarShield collaborates with your team to design custom radiation shielding built around
  performance and compliance.
  
  [Request a Quote][105]
* ## **Radiation Shielding at a Glance**
  
  See how MarShield supports medical and nuclear environments with high-integrity shielding systems.
  
  [View Our Brochure][106]

## **Radiation Shielding Products for Nuclear Medicine, Nuclear Energy, and NDT**
* ### [**Lead Lined Cabinets**][107]
  
  Custom and standard lead lined cabinets designed for secure storage and shielding in nuclear
  medicine and nuclear energy environments.
  
  [Explore Lead Lined Cabinets][108]
* ### [**L-Block Shields**][109]
  
  99.9% pure lead brick caves engineered for reliable lateral shielding in hot labs and nuclear
  medicine applications, with configurations that simplify installation.
  
  [Explore L-Bricks][110]
* ### [**Rolling Barriers**][111]
  
  Standard and custom mobile radiation barriers built with lead glass or lead acrylic viewing panels
  for dependable protection, clear visibility, and flexible use in medical and controlled
  environments.
  
  [Explore Our Rolling Barriers][112]
* ### [**Nuclear Energy Lead Pours**][113]
  
  ISO 9001:2015 and N299.3-16 certified nuclear lead pours backed by documented, industry-approved
  procedures.
  
  [Explore Nuclear Leaad Pours][114]
* ### [**Lead Bricks**][115]
  
  A full range of straight & interlocking lead bricks designed for flexible shielding configurations
  across nuclear, medical, and industrial environments.
  
  [Explore Lead Bricks][116]
* ### [**Honeycomb Wave Guides**][117]
  
  Hex cell waveguide air vents engineered to treat HVAC penetrations in RF shielded enclosures,
  delivering strong attenuation across key frequencies while maintaining low pressure drop.
  
  [Explore RF Wave Guides][118]

## Why Choose MarShield for Your Radiation Shielding Needs

MarShield partners with you to develop a radiation shielding solution aligned with your project
needs, guiding and supporting you through every stage.
* ### Custom-Built For Your Environment
  
  Standard products create gaps in performance. We design radiation shielding systems around your
  layout, workflow, and compliance requirements to ensure proper fit and function.
* ### A Partner Beyond
  ### Installation
  
  MarShield continues to support your team after delivery with expert guidance, maintenance
  assistance, and technical insight to help you stay compliant and operational.
* ### 45+ Years Radiation Protection Expertise
  
  We have in-depth industry knowledge across healthcare, nuclear, and industrial sectors. Our
  certifications, including CSA-N299.3-16 and ISO 9001:2015, reflect that standard.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Radiation Shielding

Do you provide radiation shielding for nuclear energy facilities?

Yes. MarShield designs and manufactures radiation shielding solutions for nuclear energy facilities,
including engineered lead pours and fills and custom lead assemblies. For nuclear applications,
MarShield operates under an ISO 9001:2015 quality management system and applicable CSA N299.3
requirements, supporting project‑specific technical and regulatory compliance.

What radiation shielding solutions do you provide for hospitals and medical facilities?

MarShield supplies radiation shielding solutions for medical imaging, radiology, and nuclear
medicine environments. Products include [lead bricks,][119] [L‑Block shields][120], [rolling
barriers][121], [lead‑lined cabinets and storage][122], [lead sheets][123], [leaded glass][124],
[lead acrylic][125], and custom shielding assemblies.

Do you manufacture custom radiation shielding solutions?

Yes. MarShield specializes in custom‑engineered radiation shielding and works with clients,
engineers, and installers to develop solutions that integrate into existing facilities or new
construction.

What purity level is your lead material?

Depending on application requirements, MarShield supplies lead with purity levels up to 99.9
percent. Material traceability and supporting documentation can be provided when required.

What industries does MarShield serve?

MarShield provides radiation shielding solutions** **[nuclear energy,][126] [medical imaging][127]
and [nuclear medicine][128], [industrial radiography and NDT][129], research laboratories, and
select government and defence-related applications.

Do your radiation shielding products meet Canadian and U.S. standards?

Yes. MarShield products are manufactured to meet applicable Canadian and U.S. standards as specified
by project requirements, with compliance addressed on a project‑by‑project basis.

# Radiation Shielding Products for Nuclear Energy, Nuclear Medicine and NDT

Since 1979, MarShield has been a North American leader in radiation shielding and lead shielding
manufacturing. As a trusted global supplier, we support industries where safety, compliance, and
performance are mandatory.

We work across [nuclear energy][92], [nuclear medicine][93], [diagnostic imaging][94],
[non-destructive testing][95], and design-build environments. Our team provides design guidance and
technical consultation to deliver **radiation shielding products** built to your exact
specifications.

### Our Shielding Materials:
* [Lead][96]
* [Lead Glass][97]
* [Lead Acrylic][98]
* [Non-lead Alternatives][99]
* [Tungsten][100]
* [Borated Polyethylene][101]
* [High Density Concrete][102]

[[We Design, Manufacture & Deliver]][103]

### MarShield holds CWB accreditation

MarShield Radiation Shielding holds CWB accreditation to [**CSA N299.3-16**][104] for the supply of
shielding solutions to nuclear energy facilities and regulated industries across Canada and the
United States.
* ## **Let’s Start With A Quote**
  
  MarShield collaborates with your team to design custom radiation shielding built around
  performance and compliance.
  
  [Request a Quote][105]
* ## **Radiation Shielding at a Glance**
  
  See how MarShield supports medical and nuclear environments with high-integrity shielding systems.
  
  [View Our Brochure][106]

## **Radiation Shielding Products for Nuclear Medicine, Nuclear Energy, and NDT**
* ### [**Lead Lined Cabinets**][107]
  
  Custom and standard lead lined cabinets designed for secure storage and shielding in nuclear
  medicine and nuclear energy environments.
  
  [Explore Lead Lined Cabinets][108]
* ### [**L-Block Shields**][109]
  
  99.9% pure lead brick caves engineered for reliable lateral shielding in hot labs and nuclear
  medicine applications, with configurations that simplify installation.
  
  [Explore L-Bricks][110]
* ### [**Rolling Barriers**][111]
  
  Standard and custom mobile radiation barriers built with lead glass or lead acrylic viewing panels
  for dependable protection, clear visibility, and flexible use in medical and controlled
  environments.
  
  [Explore Our Rolling Barriers][112]
* ### [**Nuclear Energy Lead Pours**][113]
  
  ISO 9001:2015 and N299.3-16 certified nuclear lead pours backed by documented, industry-approved
  procedures.
  
  [Explore Nuclear Leaad Pours][114]
* ### [**Lead Bricks**][115]
  
  A full range of straight & interlocking lead bricks designed for flexible shielding configurations
  across nuclear, medical, and industrial environments.
  
  [Explore Lead Bricks][116]
* ### [**Honeycomb Wave Guides**][117]
  
  Hex cell waveguide air vents engineered to treat HVAC penetrations in RF shielded enclosures,
  delivering strong attenuation across key frequencies while maintaining low pressure drop.
  
  [Explore RF Wave Guides][118]

## Why Choose MarShield for Your Radiation Shielding Needs

MarShield partners with you to develop a radiation shielding solution aligned with your project
needs, guiding and supporting you through every stage.
* ### Custom-Built For Your Environment
  
  Standard products create gaps in performance. We design radiation shielding systems around your
  layout, workflow, and compliance requirements to ensure proper fit and function.
* ### A Partner Beyond
  ### Installation
  
  MarShield continues to support your team after delivery with expert guidance, maintenance
  assistance, and technical insight to help you stay compliant and operational.
* ### 45+ Years Radiation Protection Expertise
  
  We have in-depth industry knowledge across healthcare, nuclear, and industrial sectors. Our
  certifications, including CSA-N299.3-16 and ISO 9001:2015, reflect that standard.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Radiation Shielding

Do you provide radiation shielding for nuclear energy facilities?

Yes. MarShield designs and manufactures radiation shielding solutions for nuclear energy facilities,
including engineered lead pours and fills and custom lead assemblies. For nuclear applications,
MarShield operates under an ISO 9001:2015 quality management system and applicable CSA N299.3
requirements, supporting project‑specific technical and regulatory compliance.

What radiation shielding solutions do you provide for hospitals and medical facilities?

MarShield supplies radiation shielding solutions for medical imaging, radiology, and nuclear
medicine environments. Products include [lead bricks,][119] [L‑Block shields][120], [rolling
barriers][121], [lead‑lined cabinets and storage][122], [lead sheets][123], [leaded glass][124],
[lead acrylic][125], and custom shielding assemblies.

Do you manufacture custom radiation shielding solutions?

Yes. MarShield specializes in custom‑engineered radiation shielding and works with clients,
engineers, and installers to develop solutions that integrate into existing facilities or new
construction.

What purity level is your lead material?

Depending on application requirements, MarShield supplies lead with purity levels up to 99.9
percent. Material traceability and supporting documentation can be provided when required.

What industries does MarShield serve?

MarShield provides radiation shielding solutions** **[nuclear energy,][126] [medical imaging][127]
and [nuclear medicine][128], [industrial radiography and NDT][129], research laboratories, and
select government and defence-related applications.

Do your radiation shielding products meet Canadian and U.S. standards?

Yes. MarShield products are manufactured to meet applicable Canadian and U.S. standards as specified
by project requirements, with compliance addressed on a project‑by‑project basis.

## Radiation Protection Products

Barrier Technologies® is America’s leading manufacturer of **radiation protection products**. We are
committed to continual innovation and serving the medical industry by producing superior **radiation
shielding products** using high quality of **radiation shielding **materials.

## Our Radiation Protection Products

We control the quality of our products by manufacturing everything in-house. From metal fabrication
to fabric manufacturing and product assembly, all our **x ray** radiation products are created
within our facilities.

Our industry-leading products include lightweight lead-free aprons, [velcro-free thyroid
collars][29], protective gloves, leaded eye protection, [mobile lead shields][30], and many more
radiation safety products.

## Innovation in Radiation Protection Technology

Barrier Technologies’ tenacious drive to innovate is one of the qualities that sets us apart from
other radiation shield manufacturers. From leadership to engineering, every tier of our company is
motivated to develop new solutions to problems within our sphere of the medical industry.

### Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ Technology Products

Two powerful examples of our commitment to innovation are our Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ proprietary
products:
* **Ultraflex™** is an outer material for our aprons, vests, and mobile shields. Unlike traditional
  nylon, which is porous and can’t be washed, we engineered Ultraflex™ to be an antibacterial and
  stain-free fabric — helping medical personnel maintain a sterile environment.
* **MagnaGuard™** is a patented magnetic closure we developed to eliminate the use of velcro on
  aprons and thyroid guards. Studies have shown velcro to be a transmitter of dangerous bacteria and
  disease. MagnaGuard™ mitigates these risks.

Our innovative products are also inspired by our customers. For example, our breakthrough Terminator
XR™ mobile lead shields were developed after a local doctor asked us to create an alternative to
cumbersome hanging lead shields.

If you are dissatisfied with your current **radiation protection products**, contact our team and
inquire about our customization services.

## Radiation Protection Products Made in USA

From lead shields to protective eyewear, Barrier Technologies is your one-stop-shop for all things
**radiation shielding**. Our catalog includes everything necessary to build a robust, easy-to-clean
radiation protection suit:

### [Protective Aprons][31]

We offer an expansive variety of lead and lead-free aprons that can be customized to meet the unique
needs of your medical organization. Don’t have time to wait for a custom order? Then order from our
Ready To Go line of aprons — a selection of Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ equipped aprons that ship
within 24 hours of your order.

### [Radiation Protection Gloves][32]

Our lead-free and powder-free Secure Touch® gloves empower your physicians with the highest level of
**radiation shielding** in the industry. Textured fingers and palms improve grip and we’ve designed
the gloves with curved fingers and a hypoallergenic internal coating to maximize comfort.

### [Radiation Protective Eyewear][33]

Our vast catalog of leaded glasses provide the highest lead content in the industry and can be
delivered in your exact prescription. In contrast to foreign-made eyewear, our lenses don’t yellow
over time and can be coated with an anti-reflective and anti-fog coating for maximum clarity.

The unique composition of the radio protective inner core material significantly reduces the weight
of the UltraFlex apron. This provides maximum comfort compared to leaded and other non-leaded
aprons.

Stain and Fluid resistance of the urethane surface of the UltraFlex apron makes clean up and apron

procedures.

## Radiation Protection Products

Barrier Technologies® is America’s leading manufacturer of **radiation protection products**. We are
committed to continual innovation and serving the medical industry by producing superior **radiation
shielding products** using high quality of **radiation shielding **materials.

## Our Radiation Protection Products

We control the quality of our products by manufacturing everything in-house. From metal fabrication
to fabric manufacturing and product assembly, all our **x ray** radiation products are created
within our facilities.

Our industry-leading products include lightweight lead-free aprons, [velcro-free thyroid
collars][29], protective gloves, leaded eye protection, [mobile lead shields][30], and many more
radiation safety products.

## Innovation in Radiation Protection Technology

Barrier Technologies’ tenacious drive to innovate is one of the qualities that sets us apart from
other radiation shield manufacturers. From leadership to engineering, every tier of our company is
motivated to develop new solutions to problems within our sphere of the medical industry.

### Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ Technology Products

Two powerful examples of our commitment to innovation are our Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ proprietary
products:
* **Ultraflex™** is an outer material for our aprons, vests, and mobile shields. Unlike traditional
  nylon, which is porous and can’t be washed, we engineered Ultraflex™ to be an antibacterial and
  stain-free fabric — helping medical personnel maintain a sterile environment.
* **MagnaGuard™** is a patented magnetic closure we developed to eliminate the use of velcro on
  aprons and thyroid guards. Studies have shown velcro to be a transmitter of dangerous bacteria and
  disease. MagnaGuard™ mitigates these risks.

Our innovative products are also inspired by our customers. For example, our breakthrough Terminator
XR™ mobile lead shields were developed after a local doctor asked us to create an alternative to
cumbersome hanging lead shields.

If you are dissatisfied with your current **radiation protection products**, contact our team and
inquire about our customization services.

**radiation shielding**. Our catalog includes everything necessary to build a robust, easy-to-clean
radiation protection suit:

### [Protective Aprons][31]

We offer an expansive variety of lead and lead-free aprons that can be customized to meet the unique
needs of your medical organization. Don’t have time to wait for a custom order? Then order from our
Ready To Go line of aprons — a selection of Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ equipped aprons that ship
within 24 hours of your order.

### [Radiation Protection Gloves][32]

Our lead-free and powder-free Secure Touch® gloves empower your physicians with the highest level of
**radiation shielding** in the industry. Textured fingers and palms improve grip and we’ve designed
the gloves with curved fingers and a hypoallergenic internal coating to maximize comfort.

over time and can be coated with an anti-reflective and anti-fog coating for maximum clarity.

## Anti-bacterial

The anti-bacterial surface of the UltraFlex apron helps in providing the hygienic condition so
necessary during all procedures. Additives on the surface material help reduce potential cross
contamination.

[[lightweight feather icon | X Ray Lead Aprons]][47]

## Lightweight

The unique composition of the radio protective inner core material significantly reduces the weight
of the UltraFlex apron. This provides maximum comfort compared to leaded and other non-leaded
aprons.

[[stain resistant white icon | Lead Aprons]][48]

## Stain Resistant

Stain and Fluid resistance of the urethane surface of the UltraFlex apron makes clean up and apron
maintenance easier and more effective while maintaining that spotless appearance expected for
procedures.

[[flexible white icon | X Ray Lead Aprons]][49]

## Flexible

UltraFlex outer fabric has 4 way stretchability. The inner apron lining is a softer more adaptable
and breathable fabric. The combination of these two components provides the renowned flexibility of
the UltraFlex apron.

### Kids Room | Modern Bright Haven

#### This modern children’s room blends simplicity with playful charm, creating a bright and
#### cheerful space. Clean lines and minimalistic furniture provide a calm and organized
#### environment, while pops of color in textiles, wall art, and accessories add personality and
#### fun. Thoughtful storage solutions keep toys and books neatly arranged, encouraging independence
#### and tidiness. Soft rugs, cozy seating, and versatile play areas make the room both comfortable
#### and functional. Ample natural light enhances the sense of openness, creating a lively yet
#### soothing atmosphere. The design balances practicality with creativity, offering a stylish and
#### inspiring space where children can play, learn, and grow every day.

### Bedroom | Luxurious Scarlet Elegance

#### This luxurious red bedroom exudes bold sophistication and dramatic elegance. Deep red tones on
#### walls, bedding, and upholstery create a warm, intimate atmosphere, while plush textures like
#### velvet and silk add richness and comfort. Sleek metallic accents, mirrored surfaces, and
#### carefully curated lighting enhance the opulent feel without overwhelming the senses. Minimalist
#### yet refined furniture ensures functionality while maintaining a sense of grandeur. Thoughtful
#### layering of fabrics, rugs, and cushions creates depth and visual interest, balancing intensity
#### with serenity. The overall design offers a glamorous and indulgent retreat, where luxury meets
#### comfort, making the bedroom both striking and inviting.

### Outdoor Living | Modern Natural Wood

#### This modern outdoor living space embraces the warmth and texture of natural wood, creating a
#### serene and inviting retreat. Wooden decking and furniture pieces with clean lines blend
#### seamlessly with lush greenery, while neutral cushions and textiles add comfort and understated
#### elegance. Minimalist design ensures the space feels open and uncluttered, emphasizing harmony
#### with the surrounding nature. Thoughtful lighting highlights the wood’s natural grain and
#### creates a cozy ambiance for evening gatherings. Durable materials ensure longevity and
#### practicality without compromising style. The overall atmosphere is calm, organic, and
#### sophisticated, offering a perfect balance of modern design and natural tranquility for outdoor
#### living.

### Kids Room | Modern Playful Minimalism

#### This modern children’s room combines simplicity with playful energy, creating a bright and
#### inviting space. Clean lines, minimalistic furniture, and neutral base tones provide a calm
#### backdrop, while colorful accents, wall art, and soft textiles add personality and fun.
#### Thoughtful storage solutions keep toys and books organized, promoting both functionality and
#### independence. Natural light fills the room, enhancing the sense of openness and warmth. Soft
#### rugs and comfortable seating areas encourage reading, play, and relaxation. The design balances
#### practicality with creativity, offering a safe, stylish, and cheerful environment where children
#### can grow, explore, and feel inspired every day.

### Living Room | Modern Light Luxury Yellow

#### This modern light luxury living room showcases a vibrant yet sophisticated yellow palette,
#### creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. A plush velvet sofa in golden tones serves as the
#### centerpiece, offering both comfort and a touch of elegance. Clean lines, subtle metallic
#### accents, and refined furniture pieces enhance the contemporary aesthetic without overwhelming
#### the space. Natural light and carefully positioned ambient lighting emphasize textures and
#### colors, adding depth and richness. Thoughtful details like soft rugs, decorative cushions, and
#### minimalist art bring harmony to the design. The result is a chic, cozy, and luxurious living
#### space that radiates energy while maintaining modern sophistication.

### Living Room | Modern Marble Luxury

#### This modern light luxury living room is centered around the timeless elegance of marble.
#### Large-format marble surfaces with natural veining create a refined and sophisticated focal
#### point, while soft neutral tones keep the space balanced and inviting. Sleek furniture, subtle
#### metallic accents, and clean architectural lines enhance the contemporary feel without
#### overpowering the design. Carefully planned lighting highlights the texture and depth of the
#### marble, adding a sense of quiet luxury. The overall atmosphere is elegant yet comfortable,
#### blending premium materials with modern simplicity to create a living space that feels polished,
#### calm, and enduring.

### Laundry Room | Modern Clean Function

#### This modern laundry room is designed with clarity, efficiency, and simplicity in mind. A
#### neutral color palette, sleek cabinetry, and smooth surfaces create a clean and organized visual
#### experience. Built-in storage and integrated appliances maximize space while keeping the room
#### clutter-free. Subtle lighting and minimal detailing highlight the functional layout without
#### unnecessary decoration. Durable materials ensure easy maintenance, making the space practical
#### for daily use. Overall, the design focuses on smart functionality and modern aesthetics,
#### transforming the laundry room into a streamlined, comfortable, and highly efficient part of the
#### home.

### Living Room | Modern Retro Harmony

#### This modern retro living room blends classic character with contemporary comfort.
#### Vintage-inspired furniture silhouettes and warm color tones are balanced with clean lines and
#### modern materials, creating a space that feels both nostalgic and fresh. Textured fabrics, wood
#### elements, and subtle metal details add depth and personality to the interior. Carefully curated
#### décor references retro design without overwhelming the space. Soft, layered lighting enhances
#### the cozy atmosphere while maintaining a modern aesthetic. The result is a welcoming living room
#### that celebrates timeless design, offering a perfect balance between past influences and
#### present-day living.

### Kids’ Room | Modern Beige Comfort

#### This modern beige kids’ room is designed to feel warm, calm, and timeless. Soft beige tones
#### create a gentle backdrop that promotes relaxation while allowing the space to grow with the
#### child. Natural materials, rounded furniture edges, and cozy textiles add a sense of safety and
#### comfort. The clean, modern layout keeps the room organized and functional, with smart storage
#### solutions for toys and books. Subtle color variations and textures prevent the palette from
#### feeling flat. Overall, the design balances aesthetics and practicality, creating a soothing yet

## [More EMI Shielding Companies][80]


### EMI Shielding Supplier Directory Overview

Find and compare EMI shielding companies that manufacture products for electronics,
telecommunications, aerospace, defense, medical, automotive, industrial automation, research, and
security applications. This directory helps buyers browse suppliers of electromagnetic interference
shielding, EMI enclosures, EMI coatings, EMI filters, RF absorbers, conductive fabrics, shielding
tapes, foils, laminates, EMI gaskets, RF gasket products, RF gaskets, and RF gasketing. Source
companies by product type, shielding method, material capability, production volume, and application
experience, then connect with manufacturers that can support prototype, custom, replacement,
retrofit, or high-volume shielding requirements for sensitive equipment and controlled environments.

### EMI Enclosures and Shielded Housing Systems

EMI enclosures surround sensitive electronics with conductive barriers that reduce unwanted
electromagnetic energy entering or leaving equipment. These enclosures may be solid, vented, or
perforated depending on airflow, visibility, access, and attenuation needs. Buyers use them for
server rooms, test labs, medical devices, industrial controls, defense electronics,
telecommunications systems, and secure communication equipment where signal integrity and equipment
reliability are critical.

### EMI Coatings and EMI Filters

EMI coatings are applied to plastic housings, device shells, cable areas, and non-conductive
surfaces to create a conductive shielding layer without the weight or space requirements of a full
metal enclosure. These coatings support electronics manufacturing, automotive assemblies, consumer
devices, instrumentation, and retrofit projects where lightweight EMI shielding is needed. EMI
filters reduce conducted noise on power, data, and signal lines, making them important for power
supplies, automation equipment, medical electronics, and communication systems.

### EMI Gaskets, RF Gaskets, and Flexible Shielding Materials

EMI gaskets, RF gasket components, RF gaskets, and RF gasketing seal seams, doors, connectors,
access panels, and enclosure gaps that could otherwise leak interference. Conductive elastomers,
metal-filled materials, and flexible sealing designs help combine environmental sealing with
shielding performance. RF absorbers manage radio-frequency and microwave energy inside chambers,
cabinets, and assemblies, while conductive fabrics, tapes, foils, and laminates provide flexible
options for cable wrapping, spot shielding, room lining, wearable electronics, and field repairs.

### Industry Applications for EMI Shielding

Medical equipment suppliers use EMI shielding for diagnostic imaging, monitoring devices,
radiation-related systems, and sensitive electronics that must operate reliably around other
equipment. Aerospace and defense applications require shielding for avionics, communications,
radar-adjacent electronics, and compact systems exposed to harsh environments. Automotive and
electric vehicle manufacturers need EMI gaskets, coatings, filters, and enclosures for sensors,
control modules, batteries, and charging systems. Telecommunications companies use shielding EMI
solutions to protect signal paths, cabinets, connectors, and network hardware. Industrial
manufacturers rely on electromagnetic interference shielding for automation controls, robotics,
power equipment, and inspection systems.

### Production Volume and Supplier Selection

Start by matching suppliers to your production volume and throughput requirements. A prototype or
low-volume custom enclosure project may need engineering support and flexible fabrication, while a
high-volume program may require repeatable tooling, coating consistency, gasket conversion,
inventory support, and documented quality controls.

### Shielding Methods and Material Capabilities

Process type matters because EMI shielding may be built into the enclosure, applied as a coating,
added through RF gasketing, or managed with filters, absorbers, foils, fabrics, or shielded
connectors. Compare suppliers by the exact shielding method they support, not just by whether they
list EMI shielding as a capability.

### Integration and Manufacturing Compatibility

Integration with existing lines should be reviewed early. Buyers may need shielding that fits
current housings, cables, cabinets, panel openings, connector layouts, or assembly steps without
slowing production or causing maintenance problems.

### Inspection, Certification, and Performance Validation

Inspection and certification requirements depend on the industry and end use. Ask suppliers how they
verify shielding effectiveness, material performance, dimensional consistency, environmental
sealing, and compliance with applicable electromagnetic compatibility, safety, and quality
requirements.

### Evaluating EMI Shielding Companies

Evaluate supplier specialization by reviewing their experience with your industry, frequency range,
material constraints, environmental exposure, and product geometry. The strongest EMI shielding
companies can explain tradeoffs between copper, aluminum, steel, nickel-based materials, conductive
elastomers, coatings, filters, absorbers, and flexible shielding products.

### FAQ

#### How do I find EMI shielding companies for a custom project?

Use a supplier directory to compare companies by product type, material capability, industry
experience, and production scale. Look for suppliers that clearly support the shielding method you
need, such as enclosures, coatings, EMI gaskets, RF gasket products, filters, absorbers, fabrics, or
foils. Share drawings, frequency concerns, environmental conditions, and production volume when
requesting quotes.

#### What type of EMI shielding is best for electronics enclosures?

The best option depends on the enclosure material, access points, seams, vents, connectors, and
frequency range. Metal enclosures may need RF gasketing around doors or panels, while plastic
housings may require conductive coatings, plating, foils, or internal shielding layers. Filters may
also be needed when interference travels through power or signal lines.

#### When should I use RF gaskets or RF gasketing?

Use RF gaskets or RF gasketing when an enclosure has seams, removable panels, doors, covers, or
connector openings that interrupt the shielding path. These components help maintain electrical
continuity while also supporting compression, sealing, and environmental protection. They are common
in telecommunications, aerospace, defense, medical, and industrial electronics.

### EMI Shielding Supplier Directory Overview

Find and compare EMI shielding companies that manufacture products for electronics,
telecommunications, aerospace, defense, medical, automotive, industrial automation, research, and
security applications. This directory helps buyers browse suppliers of electromagnetic interference
shielding, EMI enclosures, EMI coatings, EMI filters, RF absorbers, conductive fabrics, shielding
tapes, foils, laminates, EMI gaskets, RF gasket products, RF gaskets, and RF gasketing. Source
companies by product type, shielding method, material capability, production volume, and application
experience, then connect with manufacturers that can support prototype, custom, replacement,
retrofit, or high-volume shielding requirements for sensitive equipment and controlled environments.

### EMI Enclosures and Shielded Housing Systems

EMI enclosures surround sensitive electronics with conductive barriers that reduce unwanted
electromagnetic energy entering or leaving equipment. These enclosures may be solid, vented, or
perforated depending on airflow, visibility, access, and attenuation needs. Buyers use them for
server rooms, test labs, medical devices, industrial controls, defense electronics,
telecommunications systems, and secure communication equipment where signal integrity and equipment
reliability are critical.

### EMI Coatings and EMI Filters

EMI coatings are applied to plastic housings, device shells, cable areas, and non-conductive
surfaces to create a conductive shielding layer without the weight or space requirements of a full
metal enclosure. These coatings support electronics manufacturing, automotive assemblies, consumer
devices, instrumentation, and retrofit projects where lightweight EMI shielding is needed. EMI
filters reduce conducted noise on power, data, and signal lines, making them important for power
supplies, automation equipment, medical electronics, and communication systems.

### EMI Gaskets, RF Gaskets, and Flexible Shielding Materials

EMI gaskets, RF gasket components, RF gaskets, and RF gasketing seal seams, doors, connectors,
access panels, and enclosure gaps that could otherwise leak interference. Conductive elastomers,
metal-filled materials, and flexible sealing designs help combine environmental sealing with
shielding performance. RF absorbers manage radio-frequency and microwave energy inside chambers,
cabinets, and assemblies, while conductive fabrics, tapes, foils, and laminates provide flexible
options for cable wrapping, spot shielding, room lining, wearable electronics, and field repairs.

### Industry Applications for EMI Shielding

Medical equipment suppliers use EMI shielding for diagnostic imaging, monitoring devices,
radiation-related systems, and sensitive electronics that must operate reliably around other
equipment. Aerospace and defense applications require shielding for avionics, communications,
radar-adjacent electronics, and compact systems exposed to harsh environments. Automotive and
electric vehicle manufacturers need EMI gaskets, coatings, filters, and enclosures for sensors,
control modules, batteries, and charging systems. Telecommunications companies use shielding EMI
solutions to protect signal paths, cabinets, connectors, and network hardware. Industrial
manufacturers rely on electromagnetic interference shielding for automation controls, robotics,
power equipment, and inspection systems.

### Production Volume and Supplier Selection

Start by matching suppliers to your production volume and throughput requirements. A prototype or
low-volume custom enclosure project may need engineering support and flexible fabrication, while a
high-volume program may require repeatable tooling, coating consistency, gasket conversion,
inventory support, and documented quality controls.

### Shielding Methods and Material Capabilities

Process type matters because EMI shielding may be built into the enclosure, applied as a coating,
added through RF gasketing, or managed with filters, absorbers, foils, fabrics, or shielded
connectors. Compare suppliers by the exact shielding method they support, not just by whether they
list EMI shielding as a capability.

### Integration and Manufacturing Compatibility

Integration with existing lines should be reviewed early. Buyers may need shielding that fits
current housings, cables, cabinets, panel openings, connector layouts, or assembly steps without
slowing production or causing maintenance problems.

### Inspection, Certification, and Performance Validation

Inspection and certification requirements depend on the industry and end use. Ask suppliers how they
verify shielding effectiveness, material performance, dimensional consistency, environmental
sealing, and compliance with applicable electromagnetic compatibility, safety, and quality
requirements.

### Evaluating EMI Shielding Companies

Evaluate supplier specialization by reviewing their experience with your industry, frequency range,
material constraints, environmental exposure, and product geometry. The strongest EMI shielding
companies can explain tradeoffs between copper, aluminum, steel, nickel-based materials, conductive
elastomers, coatings, filters, absorbers, and flexible shielding products.

### FAQ

#### How do I find EMI shielding companies for a custom project?

Use a supplier directory to compare companies by product type, material capability, industry
experience, and production scale. Look for suppliers that clearly support the shielding method you
need, such as enclosures, coatings, EMI gaskets, RF gasket products, filters, absorbers, fabrics, or
foils. Share drawings, frequency concerns, environmental conditions, and production volume when
requesting quotes.

#### What type of EMI shielding is best for electronics enclosures?

The best option depends on the enclosure material, access points, seams, vents, connectors, and
frequency range. Metal enclosures may need RF gasketing around doors or panels, while plastic
housings may require conductive coatings, plating, foils, or internal shielding layers. Filters may
also be needed when interference travels through power or signal lines.

#### When should I use RF gaskets or RF gasketing?

Use RF gaskets or RF gasketing when an enclosure has seams, removable panels, doors, covers, or
connector openings that interrupt the shielding path. These components help maintain electrical
continuity while also supporting compression, sealing, and environmental protection. They are common
in telecommunications, aerospace, defense, medical, and industrial electronics.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

and peaceful use of nuclear technologies.

### [Nuclear Science is Transforming Rainbow Trout Farming in Latin America][158]

From freshwater rivers, lakes and lagoons to coastal marine cages, trout farming is a dynamic sub
sector of aquaculture in Latin America, which supports thousands of livelihoods across the region.
But trout raised in open water farms are vulnerable to diseases that spread easily in water.

## Radiation protection that **ticks all the boxes**

RADsafe personal radiation protective apparel is setting new standards in innovative and reliable
protection for healthcare professionals around the world.

[See Our Solutions][180] [Why Now Is the Time to Buy Australian-Made Radiation Protection][181]

## MRI-Compatible Anesthesia and Monitoring Solutions

We’re excited to showcase our latest MRI-compatible anesthesia and monitoring solutions – explore
the future of patient safety and innovation with us.

## Why EcoVue® Ultrasound Gel is the Clear Choice

# CAPABILITIES

#### Intech is a Houston-based Manufacturer of Radiation Protection Products.

We supply A&E firms, manufacturers, government and medical organizations. Our team has been at the
leading edge of radiation shielding designs using leadfree materials since 2003.  We provide:

- Composites, Alloys and Polymers for Nuclear and Gamma Radiation Shielding.

- Lead-free and Lead Curtain Shielding materials for NDT and Security Scanners.

- Radiation Shielding Designs and Solutions for most Applications and Environments.

- Barriers, Curtains and Lead Construction Materials for Shielding Work Areas & Medical Facilities.

- Custom Fabrications Manufactured from Bismuth and Tungsten Materials.

- Shielding for High Energy Laser and Electron Beam Radiation Sources.

[Read more][78] 18 December 2025 ##### 20 Years of Open Access Books: A Milestone for IntechOpen Over the past two decades, IntechOpen has grown into a global leader in open access book publishing, with an ever-expanding catalogue covering STM, as well as the social sciences and humanities. [Read more][81] 25 March 2025 ##### ResearchGate and IntechOpen Announce New Journal Home Partnership As part of our ongoing commitment to expanding the reach and visibility of open access research, we are excited to announce a new partnership with ResearchGate, the leading professional network for researchers. This collaboration will increase the reach and brand visibility of our journals through ResearchGate’s Journal Home platform. [Read more][82] 08 July 2024 ##### IntechOpen Presents Interviews for Young Scientists with Science's Leading Minds We are pleased to present a series of inspirational interviews for young researchers with some of today's leading scientists, ranging from a Nobel laureate to pioneers and innovators in various fields, including pharmacogenomics, pharmaceutical leadership, and academia. Marshall, this book offers insightful research and novel approaches, contributing to the continuous discourse on *Helicobacter pylori*-related research. [Read more][84] 11 March 2024 ##### IntechOpen Signs Open Access Institutional Agreement with Iowa State University IntechOpen signs an institutional agreement with Iowa State University of Science and Technology to support open access and cover open access publishing fees for their faculty. [Read more][85] 07 June 2023 ##### IntechOpen Becomes a UKSG Member IntechOpen is now an official member of the UKSG, the UK's largest scholarly communications community. Founded almost half a century ago, it connects the knowledge community and encourages the exchange of ideas in scholarly communication. [Read more][86] 28 March 2023 ##### IntechOpen Book Wins the 2022 International Academy of Astronautics Life Science Book Award We are thrilled that the International Academy of Astronautics has chosen IntechOpen's book "Preparation of Space Experiments", edited by Dr. Vladimir Pletser, to receive the IAA Life Science Book Award. The award is given annually to recognize excellence in publication by an Academy member or corresponding member in the field of life sciences. # Welcome to Lambert Radiation Shielding Ltd.

Welcome to Lambert Radiation Shielding Ltd.Welcome to Lambert Radiation Shielding Ltd.Welcome to
Lambert Radiation Shielding Ltd.
[Get in Touch][5]

## About Us

Lambert Radiation Shielding has been working together with Medical Health Professionals, Architects
and Diagnostic Imaging Equipment Manufacturers since 1948. 

Lambert Radiation Shielding Ltd. understands that there are many related health risks that coincide
with dealing with radiation. 
* We have installed over 8 million pounds of lead since our inception and our credibility and
  construction knowledge in radiation protection is matched by no one. 
* We are able to anticipate flaws to designs prior to construction, saving our clients enormous
  amounts, while working alongside the biggest contractors in North America like PCL, EllisDon and
  Stuart Olson Dominion.
* We have no limit to what we can shield. LINAC vaults, cyclotrons, medical and dental x-ray suites,
  Nuclear/RF and MRI shielding projects are among the long list of our specialties. 

The most important objective is that when LRS completes a project, our radiation shielding
installation is complete to the site specific Qualified Radiation Experts attenuation levels,
ensuring the safety of all. 



This provides, the Owner, the comfort that all has been done to satisfy the Radiation Protection
Act, alleviating any staff poisoning that would most likely have occurred if the shielding had been
installed with unskilled contractors, stopping any litigation that would follow.  

## Our Services
* PET CT Scanner
* Medical Diagnostic Imaging X-ray suites
* Dental X-ray suites
* X-ray Shielding Lead Glass
* Lead lined Doors
* Lead lined door/view frames
* Lead Vaults and Containers
* Demountable Radiation Shielding Enclosures
* Portable Shielding Barriers
* MRI enclosures
* Industrial X-ray Rooms
* Ionizing Radiation Protection
* Cyclotron doors
* Linear accelerator doors
* Borated polyethylene
* Brachytherapy enclosures
* Lead lined Doors
* Lead lined door/view frames
* Lead Vaults and Containers
* Demountable Radiation Shielding Enclosures
* Portable Shielding Barriers
* [Nuclear Shielding][6]
* NMR Magnet Shielding
* Cantruss longitudinal rail structures
* Professional Attenuating Calculations

## About Us

Lambert Radiation Shielding has been working together with Medical Health Professionals, Architects
and Diagnostic Imaging Equipment Manufacturers since 1948. 

Lambert Radiation Shielding Ltd. understands that there are many related health risks that coincide
with dealing with radiation. 
* We have installed over 8 million pounds of lead since our inception and our credibility and
  construction knowledge in radiation protection is matched by no one. 
* We are able to anticipate flaws to designs prior to construction, saving our clients enormous
  amounts, while working alongside the biggest contractors in North America like PCL, EllisDon and
  Stuart Olson Dominion.
* We have no limit to what we can shield. LINAC vaults, cyclotrons, medical and dental x-ray suites,
  Nuclear/RF and MRI shielding projects are among the long list of our specialties. 

The most important objective is that when LRS completes a project, our radiation shielding
installation is complete to the site specific Qualified Radiation Experts attenuation levels,
ensuring the safety of all. 



This provides, the Owner, the comfort that all has been done to satisfy the Radiation Protection
Act, alleviating any staff poisoning that would most likely have occurred if the shielding had been
installed with unskilled contractors, stopping any litigation that would follow.

# RADIATION PROTECTION AND NUCLEAR SAFETY SERVICES


Radiation Safety Awareness Saves Lives.

## About

## About

LilyKen Limited is a one-stop solution for all your radiation protection needs.LilyKen has over 12
years of experience offering radiation protection services to the Medical, Oil and Gas, Mining and
Manufacturing Industries.We help customers comply with the Nigerian Nuclear Regulatory Authority
(NNRA) regulations.We also provide high quality Radiation Protection and Safety Training

LilyKen Limited provides calibration ,repair and maintenance of radiation monitoring devices and NDT
equipment in accordance with international Standards.

We supply certified radiation protective equipment including lead aprons, thyroid shields, gonad
shields, lead goggles, lead gloves, and lead glasses for medical and industrial use.

* [delivery x ray lead clothing products everyday][123]
  
  2025 / 11 / 24
  
  We longkou kangxie medical instrument company is a 18 years old manufacturer of x ray lead
  products, we have 2 production lines to produce deep souce material--lead rubber sheet, lead
  rubber sheet can produce x ray lead apron, x ray lead clothing, x ray lead gown, x ray lead
  gloves, x ray lead cap, x ray lead collar etc. We accept small trial order every day, as well as
  big batch order, usually deliveried with shipping way or express door to door way. Also we produce
  some products related with x ray lead products or x ray lead protection, such as the lead apron
  rack can hang the lead clothings, we also can customize the sizes and models according to
  customers' needs.
* [guangzhou CMEF medical fair 2025.9.27-9.30][124]
  
  2025 / 10 / 12
  
  We just ended national holiday and start new work today, before the holiday we attended GUANGZHOU
  CMEF medical fair held from 27 sep to 30 sep, winning lots of customers'thrumb and good comments
  after showing our main products x ray lead clothing and x ray lead apron, though we met the storm
  in guangzhou , we are very pleased to attend this fair. Our products are all related with x ray
  lead protection,such as x ray lead clothing, x ray lead apron, x ray lead gown , x ray lead
  collar, x ray lead cap, x ray lead mask,x ray lead screen etc. the most important data is lead
  equivalence,  normal is 0.35mmpb and 0.5mmpb, we are the factory and we have the ability to
  customize for you.
* [x ray lead free apron][125]
  
  2025 / 09 / 01
  
  We longkou kangxie medical instrument is a 18 years old manufacturer of x ray lead products, which
  belong to class 1 instrument in China, such as x ray lead apron, x ray lead clothing, x ray lead
  glasses,x ray lead collar, x ray lead cap, x ray lead screen, x ray lead suspended screen etc.
  Also we produce and sell some related products. X ray lead apron is the most popular products
  nowadays, this is the basic items used in the radiational department, also surgical department
  sometimes need this, so we have options materials for customers to choose, normal x ray lead
  apron, super soft x ray lead apron, lead free material x ray lead apron etc.  You can find all
  related radiational products in kangxie factory, the brand we run is named  kangyun.

###### Established 1931

# Premier Building Materials Distributor

We are a wholesale building materials distributor serving lumberyards, roofing & siding
one-steppers, specialty dealers, and home centers since 1931.

[View Our Products][19] [Get In Touch][20]


## Making our customers look good since 1931.

We provide our customers with the highest quality products paired with exceptional service and
superior logistics coordination. When you choose MRS, you gain a competitive advantage in your
market, boost sales, and improve customer retention.


#### Timely Service

When you call MRS, a salesperson will greet you and provide prompt responses regarding price,
availability, and delivery date on stock items.

#### Premium Products

We align ourselves and form strategic partnerships with top-tier manufacturers in the industry to
deliver the highest quality products to our customers.  

#### Enhanced Protection

Our products are stored inside protected from harsh weather conditions. We use custom-tailored
packaging and deliver products on our fully covered side-curtain trailers.

#### Superior Logistics

We own and operate a fleet of tractors and trailers operated by experienced drivers to provide
accelerated deliveries and decreased lead times.



[About Us][21]


## Trusted by the industry’s leading brands.



## Your source for premium products.

Our carefully curated product selection ensures we bring the best quality building materials to our
markets.

materials available.

durability, and value of a building.

meet the demands of any schedule

Our exterior wall products suit nearly every style of home with a wide variety of siding and
cladding styles, textures, expressive palettes, and design options.

# Welcome to Nuclear Lead Company Inc – the Lead Shielding Manufacturing Company

 

#### **[Get A Quote Today!][60]**

## Lead Shielding for All Radioactive Applications

Lead is the only material proven to shield against all forms of ionizing radiation, making it
indispensable in radiation-shielding applications from nuclear reactors to medical X-ray labs. But
since lead is itself a toxic material, it requires the right tools, procedures, and expertise to
handle, fabricate, and transport safely.

With more than 50 years of experience crafting lead radiation shielding products for a wide variety
of applications, Nuclear Lead Co. is the preferred provider of lead radiation shielding for nuclear
power reactors, Department of Energy radiation labs, and large corporate manufacturers of
radiological equipment. Since the beginning of the atomic age, we have been in the business of
providing safety and peace of mind to people who work with dangerous materials every day.

[Custom medical lead shielding by Nuclear Lead Co.]

## Medical lead shielding

Nuclear medicine has become so commonplace that most people no longer give much thought to the
life-saving miracle of X-rays, magnetic resonance imaging, or radiation therapy. Even the
technicians and medical professionals who work with these advanced technologies every day often
don’t give a second thought to the potential danger posed by nuclear medical devices.

The [custom medical lead shielding][61] fabricated by Nuclear Lead Co. makes it possible for medical
professionals and patients alike to sleep soundly at night, knowing that the device housing keeps
the radiation safely contained and pointed in the right direction. If you manufacture nuclear
medical equipment or build nuclear medical facilities, we can fabricate and customize components to
your specifications.

[Call Us Now!][62]
[Lead radiation shielding by Nuclear Lead Co.]

## Lead radiation shielding

Whether you oversee a nuclear reactor, a Department of Energy radiation laboratory, or a gamma
sterilization company, the safety of your staff around the highly dangerous radioactive equipment is
your primary concern. You want to know your people and sensitive equipment won’t accidentally be
exposed to harmful levels of ionizing radiation. That’s why airtight lead radiation shielding should
be the most important building block of your facility.

Nuclear Lead Co. manufactures [lead radiation shielding][63] in a variety of sizes and
configurations to house your reactors, radiation sources, radioactive materials, and radioactive
waste. We manufacture our [lead products][64] to the high standards demanded by the Department of
Energy and the realities of working with highly dangerous radioactive technologies.

# Welcome to Nuclear Lead Company Inc – the Lead Shielding Manufacturing Company

 

#### **[Get A Quote Today!][60]**

## Lead Shielding for All Radioactive Applications

Lead is the only material proven to shield against all forms of ionizing radiation, making it
indispensable in radiation-shielding applications from nuclear reactors to medical X-ray labs. But
since lead is itself a toxic material, it requires the right tools, procedures, and expertise to
handle, fabricate, and transport safely.

With more than 50 years of experience crafting lead radiation shielding products for a wide variety
of applications, Nuclear Lead Co. is the preferred provider of lead radiation shielding for nuclear
power reactors, Department of Energy radiation labs, and large corporate manufacturers of
radiological equipment. Since the beginning of the atomic age, we have been in the business of
providing safety and peace of mind to people who work with dangerous materials every day.

[Custom medical lead shielding by Nuclear Lead Co.]

## Medical lead shielding

Nuclear medicine has become so commonplace that most people no longer give much thought to the
life-saving miracle of X-rays, magnetic resonance imaging, or radiation therapy. Even the
technicians and medical professionals who work with these advanced technologies every day often
don’t give a second thought to the potential danger posed by nuclear medical devices.

The [custom medical lead shielding][61] fabricated by Nuclear Lead Co. makes it possible for medical
professionals and patients alike to sleep soundly at night, knowing that the device housing keeps
the radiation safely contained and pointed in the right direction. If you manufacture nuclear
medical equipment or build nuclear medical facilities, we can fabricate and customize components to
your specifications.

[Call Us Now!][62]
[Lead radiation shielding by Nuclear Lead Co.]

## Lead radiation shielding

Whether you oversee a nuclear reactor, a Department of Energy radiation laboratory, or a gamma
sterilization company, the safety of your staff around the highly dangerous radioactive equipment is
your primary concern. You want to know your people and sensitive equipment won’t accidentally be
exposed to harmful levels of ionizing radiation. That’s why airtight lead radiation shielding should
be the most important building block of your facility.

Nuclear Lead Co. manufactures [lead radiation shielding][63] in a variety of sizes and
configurations to house your reactors, radiation sources, radioactive materials, and radioactive
waste. We manufacture our [lead products][64] to the high standards demanded by the Department of
Energy and the realities of working with highly dangerous radioactive technologies.

## Lead storage containers

Safe storage of your radioactive materials, while they are not in use, is every bit as crucial as
the lead shielding of active nuclear power and radiation sources. That’s why Nuclear Lead Co.
fabricates [lead shipping containers][65] and lead-lined storage boxes for materials ranging from
plutonium cores to uranium fuel rods to cobalt radiation sources. We also fabricate lead containers
for the storage and transport of radioactive waste.

## Lead fabrication and casting

In addition to lead castings for radiation shielding applications, Nuclear Lead Co. has the
fabrication facilities and expertise to cast and machine lead for a wide variety of commercial and
industrial applications. We cast lead counterweights for elevators, cranes, earthmoving equipment,
and naval ballasts. Custom surface painting is available for all [castings and products][66].

## 2. Construction and Delivery

[CAD Drawings][110]

## 3. Installation Assistance

Our experts can help handle the planning and coordination of your project.
[Case Studies][111]

## Offering Complete Turnkey Radiation Shielding Services

RPP is one of the few companies offering complete turnkey radiation shielding solutions. Our
expertise enables us to design and build efficient, high-performance shielded rooms, labs, and
buildings. With extensive experience working with equipment manufacturers, we also specialize in
removing outdated radiation equipment and installing new systems.

[Learn More About Our Turnkey Solutions][112]

## About Radiation Protection Products—History and Experience

With our headquarters located in Wayzata, MN, and the manufacturing and lead mill operations in
Chapel Hill, TN, [Radiation Protection Products][113] is a family-owned business that offers decades
of expertise to meet today's shielding challenges. Many of our experts bring over 20 years of
experience in the shielding industry, which we've been a part of for over 70 years.

Through our commitment to innovation, we continuously adapt our product line to save you time and
money without compromising safety or performance. We are recognized for developing a patented lead
angle system and introducing new X-ray safety glass to the industrial radiation protection market.
Explore our [past projects][114] and shielding protection construction [partners][115] for unique
insights into our capabilities and experience.

## About Radiation Protection Products—History and Experience

With our headquarters located in Wayzata, MN, and the manufacturing and lead mill operations in

### Latest News & Announcements

### Radnostix, Inc. Reports FY2026 Q1 Results - Revenue Declines 27% Primarily Due to Voluntary
### Product Recalls, Isotope Supply Disruptions, and Planned Operational Shutdown
* * Total revenue decreased 27% to $2.38 million from $3.24 million in the first quarter of 2025,
    driven by recall impacts, isotope shortages, and Co60 down time.
  * Gross profit decreased 43% to $1.15 million from $2.03 million in the prior-year period,
    reflecting recall impacts and changes in labor cost allocation.
  * Cash and cash equivalents stood at $1.35 million at quarter-end (down from $1.70 million at
    December 31, 2025), with net cash used in operating activities of $72,442.
  * Completed construction and received initial NRC license amendment for a dedicated Calibration &
    Reference Products manufacturing facility, positioning the Company for significant capacity
    expansion and product portfolio growth in 2026.
  * Completed repair and retrofit of Cobalt-60 hot cell, adding 15 to 20 years of life to the asset.
    Restarted commercial activities in Q1 2026 after more than 5 months of down time.
  * Executed mutual termination of the DUF6 asset sale agreement; Radnostix regained full control of
    these strategic assets amid the global nuclear energy boom and will evaluate development
    options, including potential license amendments for expanded uranium-related activities.

[Read More][125]
[Sodium Iodide I-131]
[Sodium Iodide I-131]

### Radnostix, Inc. has announced its FY2025 results, delivering the second-highest annual revenue
### in company history and strong performance across key segments.
* * Calibration & Reference Products grew 21%, driven by PET-focused innovation and global expansion
  * Strong performance in Theranostics despite isotope supply challenges
  * Positive operating cash flow and continued investment in infrastructure

“2025 was a year of refinement for Radnostix, where we focused on internal improvements to, which we
believe will set us up for long-term success. Despite isotope shortages and management decision to
delay Q4 cobalt-60 projects to 2026, we delivered the second-highest revenue in our history while
making substantial investments in our future. We completed critical facility upgrades, advancing our
Medical Devices pipeline, and strengthening our position as a trusted domestic supplier of
high-value radioisotope products.”

[Read More][126]

### International Isotopes Inc. Announces Company Name Change to Radnostix, Inc.

International Isotopes Inc. today announced that it has filed a Certificate of Amendment in the
State of Texas to change our legal name to Radnostix, Inc. Effective immediately, we will officially
begin to rebrand all of our operations under the Radnostix name. International Isotopes was started
in 1995 as a company focused on irradiation and manufacturing of industrial radioisotope products.
Over the years, our focus has evolved, and the name change reflects the Company’s expanding product
segments and evolving strategic focus on radioisotopes and theranostics products.

[Read More][127]
[Sodium Iodide I-131]
[Sodium Iodide I-131]

### Radnostix (formerly International Isotopes) and AFR Submit NRC Consent Request for New Mexico
### License Transfer

This filing represents an important procedural step under the previously announced agreement for AFR
to acquire INIS’s depleted uranium deconversion and fluorine processing assets for $12.5 million in
cash at closing. The NRC’s review and consent process is expected to continue through the remaining
period of the transaction’s Outside Date.

[Read More][128]

### Radnostix (formerly International Isotopes) Announces Exclusive North American Distribution and
### Service Agreement with Globalsonics Research Pty Ltd.

This strategic alliance brings together INIS’s deep capabilities in radiopharmaceuticals, medical
devices, and nuclear medicine infrastructure with Globalsonics’ state-of-the-art instrumentation for
radiation monitoring, measurement, shielding, and protection. The collaboration is designed to
enhance access to cutting-edge technology for nuclear medicine clinics, radiopharmacies, research
institutions, and regulatory bodies throughout the U.S. and Canada.

[Read More][129]

### Latest News & Announcements

### Radnostix, Inc. Reports FY2026 Q1 Results - Revenue Declines 27% Primarily Due to Voluntary
### Product Recalls, Isotope Supply Disruptions, and Planned Operational Shutdown
* * Total revenue decreased 27% to $2.38 million from $3.24 million in the first quarter of 2025,
    driven by recall impacts, isotope shortages, and Co60 down time.
  * Gross profit decreased 43% to $1.15 million from $2.03 million in the prior-year period,
    reflecting recall impacts and changes in labor cost allocation.
  * Cash and cash equivalents stood at $1.35 million at quarter-end (down from $1.70 million at
    December 31, 2025), with net cash used in operating activities of $72,442.
  * Completed construction and received initial NRC license amendment for a dedicated Calibration &
    Reference Products manufacturing facility, positioning the Company for significant capacity
    expansion and product portfolio growth in 2026.
  * Completed repair and retrofit of Cobalt-60 hot cell, adding 15 to 20 years of life to the asset.
    Restarted commercial activities in Q1 2026 after more than 5 months of down time.
  * Executed mutual termination of the DUF6 asset sale agreement; Radnostix regained full control of
    these strategic assets amid the global nuclear energy boom and will evaluate development
    options, including potential license amendments for expanded uranium-related activities.

### Radnostix, Inc. has announced its FY2025 results, delivering the second-highest annual revenue
### in company history and strong performance across key segments.
* * Calibration & Reference Products grew 21%, driven by PET-focused innovation and global expansion
  * Strong performance in Theranostics despite isotope supply challenges
  * Positive operating cash flow and continued investment in infrastructure

“2025 was a year of refinement for Radnostix, where we focused on internal improvements to, which we
believe will set us up for long-term success. Despite isotope shortages and management decision to

making substantial investments in our future. We completed critical facility upgrades, advancing our
Medical Devices pipeline, and strengthening our position as a trusted domestic supplier of
high-value radioisotope products.”

### International Isotopes Inc. Announces Company Name Change to Radnostix, Inc.

International Isotopes Inc. today announced that it has filed a Certificate of Amendment in the
State of Texas to change our legal name to Radnostix, Inc. Effective immediately, we will officially
begin to rebrand all of our operations under the Radnostix name. International Isotopes was started
in 1995 as a company focused on irradiation and manufacturing of industrial radioisotope products.
Over the years, our focus has evolved, and the name change reflects the Company’s expanding product
segments and evolving strategic focus on radioisotopes and theranostics products.

## Frequently Asked Questions

1. What are radiation shielding services and why are they important?

Radiation shielding services help protect healthcare professionals, patients, and facility staff
from unnecessary radiation exposure. Professional radiation shielding services include inspections,
testing, compliance assessments, and shielding evaluations to help ensure a safe healthcare
environment.

2. What do medical radiation shielding services include?

Medical radiation shielding services include radiation barrier assessments, shielding integrity
inspections, compliance testing, and safety evaluations for hospitals, imaging centers, dental
clinics, and other healthcare facilities. These services help facilities meet regulatory
requirements and maintain radiation safety standards.

3. How often should mobile lead apron scanning services be performed?

Mobile lead apron scanning services should be performed at least annually or according to facility
policies and regulatory guidelines. Regular scanning helps identify cracks, tears, and internal
defects that may reduce radiation protection effectiveness.

4. Can one provider handle radiation shielding services, lead apron cleaning, and lead apron
scanning?

Yes. Shield Renu provides comprehensive radiation shielding services, medical radiation shielding
services, lead apron cleaning services, and mobile lead apron scanning services to help healthcare
facilities maintain compliance, safety, and radiation protection standards through a single trusted
provider.

## Frequently Asked Questions

1. What are radiation shielding services and why are they important?

Radiation shielding services help protect healthcare professionals, patients, and facility staff
from unnecessary radiation exposure. Professional radiation shielding services include inspections,
testing, compliance assessments, and shielding evaluations to help ensure a safe healthcare
environment.

2. What do medical radiation shielding services include?

Medical radiation shielding services include radiation barrier assessments, shielding integrity
inspections, compliance testing, and safety evaluations for hospitals, imaging centers, dental
clinics, and other healthcare facilities. These services help facilities meet regulatory
requirements and maintain radiation safety standards.

3. How often should mobile lead apron scanning services be performed?

Mobile lead apron scanning services should be performed at least annually or according to facility
policies and regulatory guidelines. Regular scanning helps identify cracks, tears, and internal
defects that may reduce radiation protection effectiveness.

4. Can one provider handle radiation shielding services, lead apron cleaning, and lead apron
scanning?

Yes. Shield Renu provides comprehensive radiation shielding services, medical radiation shielding
services, lead apron cleaning services, and mobile lead apron scanning services to help healthcare
facilities maintain compliance, safety, and radiation protection standards through a single trusted
provider.

# Understanding Radiation Shielding –
# Welcome to Veritas Medical Solutions

At Veritas Medical Solutions, we understand that the primary purpose of shielding is to protect not
only patients but also staff working in or near the rooms, as well as the general public. To this
end, we have conducted significant neutron attenuation testing to ensure that our solutions meet
this important goal with 100% certainty. Guaranteed.

X-ray and gamma rays are forms of electromagnetic radiation that occur with higher energy levels
than those displayed by ultraviolet or visible light. Consequently, thick, dense shielding is
necessary to protect against the energy emitted from x-rays. Therefore, shielding and room design
are critical and consequential considerations for any healthcare facility where diagnostic and
interventional radiology are performed.

# Understanding Radiation Shielding –
# Welcome to Veritas Medical Solutions

At Veritas Medical Solutions, we understand that the primary purpose of shielding is to protect not
only patients but also staff working in or near the rooms, as well as the general public. To this
end, we have conducted significant neutron attenuation testing to ensure that our solutions meet
this important goal with 100% certainty. Guaranteed.

X-ray and gamma rays are forms of electromagnetic radiation that occur with higher energy levels
than those displayed by ultraviolet or visible light. Consequently, thick, dense shielding is
necessary to protect against the energy emitted from x-rays. Therefore, shielding and room design
are critical and consequential considerations for any healthcare facility where diagnostic and
interventional radiology are performed.

  Vitality Medical stands out as a leading online destination for discount medical supplies and

  purchasing a wide range of medical supplies online. This has made Vitality Medical a go-to source

  to helping customers find medical supplies online that fits both their needs and their budgets.

  guide you every step of the way. Our customer service team receives regular training to ensure

  For purchasing agents in hospitals, caregiver facilities, or retail, our [Business to
  Business][105] section offers tailored solutions and information to meet your specific needs.
  
  When you choose Vitality Medical as your online medical supply store, you’re choosing convenience,

  also [contact our team][106] to learn more about our products, get help navigating our
